This individual was [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jaron Kyte]]'s '''contact''' with the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]]. Any information that Kyte needed to relay to the Pirates went through this individual. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Kyte sent a communication, informing his contact that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] had possibly learned of an arrangement between the Pirates and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]] of the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]] which saw the Pirates supplying the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] with [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]] they constructed using a [[Cavrilhu Pirates Preybird production facility|production facility]] they had acquired.
